data.description:
## Context / Problem
`tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py` failed in 3 of the Nov 19-20 2026 local `make verify` runs on oversubscribed hosts and passes in CI: `test_snapshot_repair_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` with "SETUP: the merge must land B's tag" (verify-willet.log) and "SETUP: A must hold a COMMENT orphan to repair" (bug-create-replay make-verify.log), and `test_fold_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` (fix-ref-lock-test-bound). Both are setup assertions, not the behavior under test.

## Root cause (verified)
Each test drives two clones through real `rebar` child processes and then reads the other clone's writes with an explicit `git fetch origin tickets`. Those writes reach origin only through rebar's post-write push, which is best-effort by design: `push_tickets_branch` bounds `git push` at `_GIT_TIMEOUT = 30` s and a timeout never fails the write (`src/rebar/_store/push.py`). On a starved host a push can exceed 30 s, the write still exits 0, and the next fetch does not contain it, so the setup precondition fails. The tests already make the fetch side a checked precondition (`_sync_from_origin`, whose docstring says production delivery is best-effort), but rely on the push side succeeding.

Deterministic reproduction (Nov 20 2026, origin/main 8e1d15e664f): a PATH `git` shim that sleeps 32 s before any `git push` makes every best-effort push time out. `test_snapshot_repair_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` then fails at setup every run (here clone B cannot see A's unpublished ticket: `rebar comment ... Error: ticket '...' not found`); without the shim it passes.

## Approach
Make delivery a checked precondition, the same way `_sync_from_origin` already treats fetches: add a `_publish(tracker)` helper in the test module that runs a checked `git push -q origin HEAD:tickets` from that clone's tracker (a no-op when the best-effort push already landed), and call it after every write whose arrival at origin the next step depends on: A's create and comment, B's comment, and B's tag edit. The helper's docstring says why (best-effort production push, 30 s bound). The behavior under test (fold and snapshot repair placement, orphan detection) is unchanged, and no product code changes.

## Scope
- `tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py`

## Testing
- Under the 32 s push shim, both tests pass after the change (they fail before it), run recorded on this ticket.
- Without the shim both tests still pass.
- The module's existing assertions on SNAPSHOT placement, tag survival and fsck orphan rows are unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both fold cross-clone tests pass under the 32 s push shim and without it, runs recorded here.
- [ ] Every cross-clone read in the module follows a checked publish of the write it depends on.
- [ ] `make verify` passes on the change and Gerrit gives Verified +1.
data.title: Fold cross-clone tests assume best-effort pushes landed; a push past its 30 s bound breaks their setup
